text: 天上鱼鳞斑，明日晒谷不用翻
pinyin: tiān shàng yú lín bān, míng rì shài gǔ bù yòng fān
literal: sky · above · fish · scales · patches, tomorrow · sun · grain · no · need · turn over
natural: Fish-scale clouds today, no need to turn the grain tomorrow

meaning.en: Mackerel sky means tomorrow will be sunny and dry, so the grain will dry without turning.
meaning.zh: 天上出现鱼鳞状的云，说明明天是晴天，晒谷子都不用翻。

equivalents: Mackerel sky and mares' tails make tall ships carry low sails

examples.zh: 爷爷看了看云说：“天上鱼鳞斑，明日晒谷不用翻，明天是个大晴天。”
examples.en: Grandpa glanced at the clouds and said, "Fish-scale clouds today, no need to turn the grain tomorrow; it'll be fine."

examples.zh: 天上鱼鳞斑，明日晒谷不用翻，咱们明天可以放心晒粮食了。
examples.en: Fish-scale clouds today, no need to turn the grain tomorrow; we can safely dry the harvest.

usage.en: A weather proverb about cirrocumulus clouds. Folk forecasts like this vary by region.
usage.zh: 天气谚语，指鱼鳞状的卷积云。各地经验不尽相同。

text: 日晕三更雨，月晕午时风
pinyin: rì yùn sān gēng yǔ, yuè yùn wǔ shí fēng
literal: sun · halo · third watch · rain, moon · halo · noon · wind
natural: A halo round the sun brings rain by midnight; a halo round the moon brings wind by noon

meaning.en: Weather lore: a sun halo foretells rain, a moon halo foretells wind.
meaning.zh: 天气谚语：太阳周围出现光圈预示下雨，月亮周围出现光圈预示刮风。

equivalents: A ring around the moon means rain soon
Ring around the sun or moon, rain or snow coming soon

examples.zh: 老渔民说：“日晕三更雨，月晕午时风，今晚得把船拴牢。”
examples.en: The old fisherman said, "A sun halo means rain, a moon halo means wind; tie the boats up tight tonight."

examples.zh: 日晕三更雨，月晕午时风，这是老辈人看天的经验。
examples.en: Halo round the sun means rain, halo round the moon means wind; that's how the old folk read the sky.

usage.en: 三更 is around midnight; here it simply means 'soon'. Folk weather saying.
usage.zh: 三更指半夜，这里泛指不久。民间天气谚语。

text: 蚂蚁搬家蛇过道，大雨马上就来到
pinyin: mǎ yǐ bān jiā shé guò dào, dà yǔ mǎ shàng jiù lái dào
literal: ants · move · house · snake · cross · path, heavy · rain · at once · soon · arrive
natural: Ants moving house and snakes crossing the path: heavy rain is on its way

meaning.en: When ants relocate and snakes cross the road, a downpour is coming.
meaning.zh: 蚂蚁成群搬家、蛇横过道路，是大雨即将来临的征兆。

equivalents: Ants moving their eggs means rain is coming

examples.zh: 蚂蚁搬家蛇过道，大雨马上就来到，赶紧把衣服收进来！
examples.en: Ants on the move and snakes on the path mean heavy rain is coming; quick, bring the washing in!

examples.zh: 奶奶常说蚂蚁搬家蛇过道，大雨马上就来到，果然下午就下起了暴雨。
examples.en: Grandma often says that ants moving house and snakes crossing the road mean heavy rain; sure enough, a storm broke that afternoon.

usage.en: Folk weather lore based on animal behaviour. Often said with a rhyme-like rhythm.
usage.zh: 根据动物活动预测天气的民间谚语，读来押韵。

text: 春捂秋冻，不生杂病
pinyin: chūn wǔ qiū dòng, bù shēng zá bìng
literal: spring · keep warm · autumn · be a little cold, not · get · assorted · illness
natural: Keep wrapped up in spring and stay a bit cool in autumn, and you won't fall ill

meaning.en: Don't shed warm clothes too early in spring or add them too early in autumn, and you will avoid common ailments.
meaning.zh: 春天不要急着减衣，秋天不要急着加衣，身体就不容易生病。

equivalents: Ne'er cast a clout till May be out

examples.zh: 医生提醒：春捂秋冻，不生杂病，早春别急着换短袖。
examples.en: The doctor reminds us not to switch to short sleeves too early in spring.

examples.zh: 妈妈总说春捂秋冻，不生杂病，所以三月了还让我穿着棉袄。
examples.en: Mum always says to keep warm in spring and be a little cold in autumn, so she still makes me wear a padded jacket in March.

usage.en: Traditional health advice; 捂 (wǔ) means to keep covered and warm. Often shortened to 春捂秋冻.
usage.zh: 传统养生谚语。“捂”指保暖。常简说“春捂秋冻”。

text: 冬吃萝卜夏吃姜，不用医生开药方
pinyin: dōng chī luó bo xià chī jiāng, bù yòng yī shēng kāi yào fāng
literal: winter · eat · radish · summer · eat · ginger, no · need · doctor · write · prescription
natural: Radish in winter and ginger in summer, and you need no doctor's prescription

meaning.en: Eating seasonal foods keeps you healthy without medicine.
meaning.zh: 冬天吃萝卜、夏天吃姜，顺应时令饮食，身体健康，不用吃药。

equivalents: An apple a day keeps the doctor away

examples.zh: 冬吃萝卜夏吃姜，不用医生开药方，今天炖点萝卜汤吧。
examples.en: Radish in winter and ginger in summer keep the doctor away; let's make radish soup today.

examples.zh: 外婆信奉冬吃萝卜夏吃姜，不用医生开药方，夏天每顿都要配点姜丝。
examples.en: Grandma swears by radish in winter and ginger in summer, and has a little shredded ginger with every meal in summer.

usage.en: Folk dietary wisdom; not medical advice. Variants swap 药方 for other endings.
usage.zh: 民间饮食养生谚语，并非医学建议。

text: 夏练三伏，冬练三九
pinyin: xià liàn sān fú, dōng liàn sān jiǔ
literal: summer · train · three fu (hottest days), winter · train · three nine (coldest days)
natural: Train in the dog days of summer and the depths of winter

meaning.en: To master a skill you must keep practising through the hottest and coldest weather.
meaning.zh: 要练好本领，必须不畏酷暑严寒，坚持刻苦锻炼。

examples.zh: 夏练三伏，冬练三九，运动员每天的训练从不间断。
examples.en: Train in the dog days and in deep winter: the athletes never skip a day of practice.

examples.zh: 他夏练三伏，冬练三九，才有了今天的成绩。
examples.en: He trained through the hottest and coldest days, which is how he achieved today's results.

usage.en: 三伏 is the hottest period of summer; 三九 the coldest of winter. Often seen in sports and martial arts.
usage.zh: 三伏是夏季最热的时期，三九是冬季最冷的时期。多用于体育、武术。

text: 人误地一时，地误人一年
pinyin: rén wù dì yī shí, dì wù rén yī nián
literal: person · neglect · land · one · moment, land · cost · person · one · year
natural: If you neglect the land for a moment, it costs you a year

meaning.en: Missing the right time for farm work harms the whole year's harvest.
meaning.zh: 人一时偷懒误了农时，地里一年的收成就受影响。

equivalents: A stitch in time saves nine
Make hay while the sun shines

examples.zh: 人误地一时，地误人一年，春耕可不能拖。
examples.en: Neglect the land for a moment and it costs you a year; spring ploughing can't wait.

examples.zh: 人误地一时，地误人一年，错过了播种期，一年都白忙。
examples.en: Miss the sowing season and the whole year's work is wasted.

usage.en: Also extended to any task with a fixed window of opportunity.
usage.zh: 也可引申指任何错过时机就会损失重大的事。

text: 庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家
pinyin: zhuāng jia yī zhī huā, quán kào féi dāng jiā
literal: crops · one · stalk · flower, entirely · rely · fertiliser · run the household
natural: Crops are like flowers, and fertiliser is the one in charge

meaning.en: Crops depend on fertiliser to grow well.
meaning.zh: 庄稼像一枝花，要长得好，全靠施肥。

examples.zh: 庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家，今年得多施点底肥。
examples.en: Crops are like flowers and depend on fertiliser, so we must apply more base fertiliser this year.

examples.zh: 老农常说庄稼一枝花，全靠肥当家，所以每年都攒农家肥。
examples.en: The old farmer often says crops depend on fertiliser, so he stockpiles manure every year.

usage.en: Agricultural proverb; 当家 means 'to manage the household', i.e. to be the key factor.
usage.zh: 农谚。“当家”指起决定作用。

synonyms: 水是庄稼血，肥是庄稼粮

text: 立春一日，水暖三分
pinyin: lì chūn yī rì, shuǐ nuǎn sān fēn
literal: start of spring · one · day, water · warm · three · tenths
natural: One day after the start of spring, the water is three tenths warmer

meaning.en: From the start of spring the water begins to warm up.
meaning.zh: 立春这一天过后，河水就开始变暖。

examples.zh: 立春一日，水暖三分，河边已经有人在钓鱼了。
examples.en: One day into spring the water has warmed a little, and people are already fishing by the river.

examples.zh: 俗话说立春一日，水暖三分，冬天总算快过去了。
examples.en: As the saying goes, the water warms from the start of spring; winter is nearly over.

usage.en: 立春 (Lìchūn) is the first of the 24 solar terms, around 4 February.
usage.zh: 立春是二十四节气之首，约在二月四日。

text: 头伏饺子二伏面，三伏烙饼摊鸡蛋
pinyin: tóu fú jiǎo zi èr fú miàn, sān fú lào bǐng tān jī dàn
literal: first fu · dumplings · second fu · noodles, third fu · pan-fried flatbread · fry · egg
natural: Dumplings on the first fu, noodles on the second, flatbread and eggs on the third

meaning.en: Northern custom of what to eat in each stage of the hottest days of summer.
meaning.zh: 北方习俗，三伏天每一伏有各自应时的吃食。

examples.zh: 头伏饺子二伏面，三伏烙饼摊鸡蛋，今天头伏，晚上包饺子吧！
examples.en: Dumplings on the first fu, noodles on the second; it's the first fu today, so let's make dumplings tonight!

examples.zh: 北京人讲究头伏饺子二伏面，三伏烙饼摊鸡蛋。
examples.en: Beijingers stick to dumplings on the first fu, noodles on the second, and flatbread and eggs on the third.

usage.en: Food custom of North China; 伏 (fú) is the hot period of roughly 30–40 days after the summer solstice.
usage.zh: 北方饮食习俗。伏指夏至后最热的一段时间。

text: 一场秋雨一场寒
pinyin: yī chǎng qiū yǔ yī chǎng hán
literal: one · spell · autumn · rain · one · spell · cold
natural: Each autumn rain brings a cold snap

meaning.en: With every autumn rainfall, the weather gets colder.
meaning.zh: 秋天每下一场雨，天气就更冷一些。

examples.zh: 一场秋雨一场寒，出门记得多加件衣服。
examples.en: Each autumn rain makes it colder; remember to wear an extra layer.

examples.zh: 一场秋雨一场寒，转眼就要入冬了。
examples.en: Every autumn shower brings a chill, and winter will soon be here.

usage.en: Very common in everyday small talk about the weather in autumn.
usage.zh: 秋季日常寒暄中很常用。

text: 冷在三九，热在三伏
pinyin: lěng zài sān jiǔ, rè zài sān fú
literal: cold · lies in · three nine, hot · lies in · three fu
natural: The coldest days are in 三九, the hottest in 三伏

meaning.en: The peak of winter cold is in sān jiǔ, and the peak of summer heat is in sān fú.
meaning.zh: 一年中最冷的时候是三九，最热的时候是三伏。

equivalents: The dead of winter and the dog days of summer

examples.zh: 冷在三九，热在三伏，现在正是一年里最热的时候。
examples.en: The hottest days of the year are in the three fu, and we're right in them.

examples.zh: 冷在三九，热在三伏，再熬几天就好了。
examples.en: Cold peaks in three nine and heat in three fu; just a few more days to endure.

usage.en: 三九 is days 19–27 after the winter solstice; 三伏 follows the summer solstice.
usage.zh: 三九在冬至后第三个九天，三伏在夏至之后。

text: 今冬麦盖三层被，来年枕着馒头睡
pinyin: jīn dōng mài gài sān céng bèi, lái nián zhěn zhe mán tou shuì
literal: this · winter · wheat · covered · three · layers · quilt, next · year · pillow · steamed bun · sleep
natural: If wheat has three quilts of snow this winter, next year you'll sleep on a pillow of steamed buns

meaning.en: Heavy winter snow protects the wheat and promises a bumper harvest.
meaning.zh: 冬天积雪厚，对麦苗有保护作用，预示来年丰收。

equivalents: A snow year, a rich year

examples.zh: 今冬麦盖三层被，来年枕着馒头睡，这场大雪来得真及时。
examples.en: Three quilts of snow on the wheat this winter means a rich harvest next year; this snow came at the right time.

examples.zh: 农民们看着满地的雪，笑着说今冬麦盖三层被，来年枕着馒头睡。
examples.en: Looking at the snow-covered fields, the farmers smiled and said a good snow now means plenty of steamed buns next year.

usage.en: Often paired with 瑞雪兆丰年. 三层被 means a thick blanket of snow.
usage.zh: 常与“瑞雪兆丰年”联系。“三层被”指厚厚的积雪。

text: 乌云接落日，不是风就是雨
pinyin: wū yún jiē luò rì, bù shì fēng jiù shì yǔ
literal: dark · clouds · meet · setting · sun, not · is · wind · then · is · rain
natural: Dark clouds meeting the setting sun mean wind or rain

meaning.en: If black clouds gather on the horizon at sunset, wind or rain will follow.
meaning.zh: 傍晚乌云遮住落日，往往预示要刮风或下雨。

equivalents: Dark clouds at sunset bring wind or rain

examples.zh: 乌云接落日，不是风就是雨，晚上别出海了。
examples.en: Black clouds at sunset mean wind or rain; don't go out to sea tonight.

examples.zh: 乌云接落日，不是风就是雨，快回家吧。
examples.en: Dark clouds on the setting sun mean wind or rain; let's hurry home.

usage.en: Weather proverb, a counterpart to sayings about red sunsets meaning fine weather.
usage.zh: 天气谚语，与“晚霞行千里”相对。

text: 一个和尚挑水吃，两个和尚抬水吃，三个和尚没水吃
pinyin: yī gè hé shang tiāo shuǐ chī, liǎng gè hé shang tái shuǐ chī, sān gè hé shang méi shuǐ chī
literal: one · monk · carry · water · drink, two · monks · lift together · water · drink, three · monks · no · water · drink
natural: One monk carries water, two carry it between them, three go without

meaning.en: The more people involved, the more they shirk and rely on each other, so the job doesn't get done.
meaning.zh: 人多了反而互相推诿，谁都不肯干，事情就办不成。

equivalents: Too many cooks spoil the broth
What is everybody's business is nobody's business

examples.zh: 一个和尚挑水吃，两个和尚抬水吃，三个和尚没水吃，办公室的卫生就是这样没人管了。
examples.en: One monk carries water, three go thirsty; that's how nobody ended up cleaning the office.

examples.zh: 项目组人一多就互相推诿，真是三个和尚没水吃。
examples.en: Once the team got bigger they all started passing the buck; truly 'three monks and no water'.

usage.en: Often shortened to 三个和尚没水吃, itself used as a quip about shirking in groups.
usage.zh: 常简说“三个和尚没水吃”，讽刺人多反而互相推诿。

text: 一样米养百样人
pinyin: yī yàng mǐ yǎng bǎi yàng rén
literal: one · kind · rice · raise · hundred · kinds · people
natural: The same rice feeds a hundred kinds of people

meaning.en: People are all different even when they grow up in the same way.
meaning.zh: 同样的米养出各种各样的人，说明人和人的性格、品行各不相同。

equivalents: It takes all sorts to make a world

examples.zh: 一样米养百样人，同一个家里的兄弟性格也大不一样。
examples.en: Brothers from the same home can be completely different; the same rice feeds a hundred kinds of people.

examples.zh: 一样米养百样人，客户什么样的都有，要学会应对。
examples.en: All sorts of customers exist; you have to learn to deal with them.

usage.en: Used to explain, or excuse, differences in people.
usage.zh: 用来解释或宽容人与人的差异。

text: 人比人，气死人
pinyin: rén bǐ rén, qì sǐ rén
literal: person · compare · person, anger · to death · person
natural: Compare people with people and you'll be furious

meaning.en: Comparing yourself with others only makes you upset.
meaning.zh: 拿自己和别人比，只会让自己生气、不平衡。

examples.zh: 人比人，气死人，同学买了新车，我还在挤地铁。
examples.en: Comparisons are odious: my classmate bought a new car and I'm still squeezed on the metro.

examples.zh: 人比人，气死人，还是过好自己的日子吧。
examples.en: It's pointless to compare; just live your own life well.

usage.en: Often a half-joking lament, sometimes followed by 货比货，得扔。
usage.zh: 常半开玩笑地感叹。

text: 人是铁，饭是钢
pinyin: rén shì tiě, fàn shì gāng
literal: person · is · iron, meal · is · steel
natural: A person is iron and meals are steel

meaning.en: People need regular meals to keep their strength.
meaning.zh: 人要有力气，全靠按时吃饭。

equivalents: An army marches on its stomach

examples.zh: 人是铁，饭是钢，再忙也要按时吃午饭。
examples.en: A person is iron and meals are steel; however busy you are, eat lunch on time.

examples.zh: 人是铁，饭是钢，一顿不吃饿得慌。
examples.en: Man is iron and food is steel; miss a meal and you feel awful.

usage.en: Often continues 一顿不吃饿得慌. Used to urge someone to eat.
usage.zh: 后面常接“一顿不吃饿得慌”。多用来劝人吃饭。

text: 人不为己，天诛地灭
pinyin: rén bù wèi jǐ, tiān zhū dì miè
literal: person · not · for · self, heaven · punish · earth · destroy
natural: If a man doesn't look out for himself, heaven and earth will destroy him

meaning.en: A cynical creed that everyone must put their own interests first.
meaning.zh: 一种极端利己的处世哲学：人不为自己打算就会遭殃。

examples.zh: 他把“人不为己，天诛地灭”挂在嘴边，难怪没有朋友。
examples.en: He keeps repeating 'every man for himself', no wonder he has no friends.

examples.zh: 人不为己，天诛地灭，这种想法太自私了。
examples.en: 'Look out for yourself or perish' is a selfish way of thinking.

usage.en: Usually quoted critically as a cynical egoist creed; some claim 为己 originally meant self-cultivation.
usage.zh: 多作批评口吻引用，表示极端自私。

text: 人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥
pinyin: rén wú hèng cái bù fù, mǎ wú yè cǎo bù féi
literal: person · without · windfall · not · rich, horse · without · night · fodder · not · fat
natural: A man doesn't get rich without a windfall, a horse doesn't fatten without night fodder

meaning.en: Nobody gets rich from regular income alone; extra gains are needed.
meaning.zh: 光靠正常收入发不了财，要有额外之财才能致富。

examples.zh: 人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥，他总想着一夜暴富。
examples.en: 'No windfall, no wealth,' he always thinks, hoping to get rich overnight.

examples.zh: 老板说人无横财不富，马无夜草不肥，可我觉得踏实干活才是正道。
examples.en: The boss says there's no wealth without a windfall, but I think honest work is the right way.

usage.en: A traditional saying about wealth; sometimes cited to justify dubious money-making, so use with care.
usage.zh: 旧时关于发财的说法，有时被用来为不义之财辩解。

text: 人有失手，马有失蹄
pinyin: rén yǒu shī shǒu, mǎ yǒu shī tí
literal: person · has · slip of hand, horse · has · slip of hoof
natural: People can slip and horses can stumble

meaning.en: Even experts make mistakes sometimes.
meaning.zh: 再有本事的人也有出错的时候。

examples.zh: 人有失手，马有失蹄，别太自责了。
examples.en: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes; don't blame yourself too much.

examples.zh: 人有失手，马有失蹄，老师傅也有算错的时候。
examples.en: Even the old master sometimes miscalculates.

usage.en: Used to console, or to excuse mistakes by capable people.
usage.zh: 常用来安慰或为能人的失误开脱。

text: 人靠衣装，佛靠金装
pinyin: rén kào yī zhuāng, fó kào jīn zhuāng
literal: person · rely on · clothes, Buddha · rely on · gold gilding
natural: People depend on clothes, Buddhas on gilding

meaning.en: Good clothes make a person look impressive, as gold leaf does a Buddha statue.
meaning.zh: 人要打扮得体才显得精神，就像佛像要贴金才显得庄严。

examples.zh: 人靠衣装，佛靠金装，面试前最好穿得正式一点。
examples.en: Clothes make the man; it's best to dress formally for an interview.

examples.zh: 人靠衣装，佛靠金装，换了身西装，他整个人都精神了。
examples.en: In a new suit he looks like a different man.

usage.en: Variant forms: 佛要金装，人要衣装 (see separate entry).
usage.zh: 相近的说法有“佛要金装，人要衣装”。

text: 人活一口气，佛争一炷香
pinyin: rén huó yī kǒu qì, fó zhēng yī zhù xiāng
literal: person · live · one · breath, Buddha · compete for · one · stick of incense
natural: People live for a breath of pride, Buddhas contend for a stick of incense

meaning.en: Everyone needs self-respect and should strive to prove themselves.
meaning.zh: 人活着要有志气、争一口气，就像佛像也要争香火。

examples.zh: 人活一口气，佛争一炷香，这次一定要证明给他们看。
examples.en: One lives for pride; this time I'll prove it to them.

examples.zh: 人活一口气，佛争一炷香，他不肯认输。
examples.en: People live for their self-respect, and he refuses to admit defeat.

usage.en: Used to motivate oneself or others to show spirit.
usage.zh: 多用于激励自己或别人要有志气。

text: 人过留名，雁过留声
pinyin: rén guò liú míng, yàn guò liú shēng
literal: person · pass · leave · name, wild goose · pass · leave · cry
natural: A person leaves a name behind, as a wild goose leaves its cry

meaning.en: One should leave a good name or lasting achievements after passing through life.
meaning.zh: 人一生走过，应该留下好名声或业绩，如同大雁飞过留下鸣声。

examples.zh: 人过留名，雁过留声，他想在这座城市留下点什么。
examples.en: A person leaves a name behind, like a goose its cry; he wants to leave something in this city.

examples.zh: 人过留名，雁过留声，做官一任就要造福一方。
examples.en: Leave a name behind; an official should benefit the people during his term.

usage.en: Often in praise of those who do something lasting. Also used neutrally of leaving traces.
usage.zh: 多用于称赞做出实绩的人。

text: 人生不如意事十之八九
pinyin: rén shēng bù rú yì shì shí zhī bā jiǔ
literal: life · not · as one wishes · matters · ten · of · eight · nine
natural: Eight or nine things in ten in life don't go as we wish

meaning.en: Life is full of disappointments, most things don't go as one hopes.
meaning.zh: 人生中不顺心的事情占绝大多数。

equivalents: Life is full of ups and downs
You can't always get what you want

examples.zh: 人生不如意事十之八九，想开点吧。
examples.en: Life seldom goes as we wish; try to take a broader view.

examples.zh: 人生不如意事十之八九，能与人言者无二三。
examples.en: Eight or nine of ten things in life go wrong, and few can be told to others.

usage.en: Often followed by 常想一二 ('think of the one or two that go well'). Said to comfort someone.
usage.zh: 常接“常想一二”。用于安慰人。
